purpose: Establish source SAE components that exchange one arithmetic digit while preserving the other under conflicting donors
dataset_revision: CCAD original deterministic paired addition development panel v1
budget: One local RTX5070Ti via gpu-0 after training releases it; 40 source masks on128conflicting-donor pairs; source-only development,<=2400wall seconds, no external service
scope: Source development: operands10..49, two-digit sums20..98 including carries. Hash split groups unordered operand pairs across templates. Source features use Fisher label separation and the difference between unit/tens Fisher scores on fit activations, without output gradients or target dictionaries. Every donor changes both answer digits; a hybrid result must change just the requested digit. The intervention acts at the original prompt-final state throughout real autoregressive generation, never at a supplied correct answer prefix. Source behavior and failed base problems are retained. This adapts published digit-circuit selection/patching, not a novel arithmetic mechanism claim. Cross-seed correspondence and independent confirmation follow validated source functionality.
statistics_unit: Unordered operand pairs remain in the same split and prompt-connected recipient-donor pairs; five controlled source SAE initializations with common prompts
